# Inventory: Get Transfer Lots

Area overview and notes: [inventory.md](../inventory.md)

`GET /transfer-lots/transactions/{transactionId}` · tenant-scoped token

Get the Transfer Lots for a transfer-in ("deposit") or transfer-out ("withdraw") transaction.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `transactionId` | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. |

**Response 200**: Get Transfer Lots response

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. |
| `transaction_type` | string | Yes | Type of the transaction. A transfer-in transaction is "deposit"; a transfer-out transaction is "withdraw". One of: `deposit`, `withdraw`. |
| `effective_datetime` | string (date-time) | No | ISO-8601 timestamp representing the date from which the user-entered cost basis information is applied. Only present if explicitly set by the user. |
| `transfer_lots` | array of object | No | List of transfer lots associated with the transaction. |
| `transfer_lots[].quantity` | string (decimal) | Yes | Amount of the asset being transferred. |
| `transfer_lots[].cost_basis` | string (decimal) | Yes | Nullable. |
| `transfer_lots[].acquisition_transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the lot was acquired. Nullable. |
| `transfer_lots[].client_acquisition_transaction_id` | string | No | The customer transaction ID that (if applicable) added the original lot to inventory. |
| `transfer_lots[].created_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the transfer lot record was created. |
| `transfer_lots[].modified_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the transfer lot was modified. |

**Response 203**: Get Transfer Lots response with warnings

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the transaction. |
| `transaction_type` | string | Yes | Type of the transaction. A transfer-in transaction is "deposit"; a transfer-out transaction is "withdraw". One of: `deposit`, `withdraw`. |
| `effective_datetime` | string (date-time) | No | ISO-8601 timestamp representing the date from which the user-entered cost basis information is applied. Only present if explicitly set by the user. |
| `transfer_lots` | array of object | No | List of transfer lots associated with the transaction. |
| `transfer_lots[].quantity` | string (decimal) | Yes | Amount of the asset being transferred. |
| `transfer_lots[].cost_basis` | string (decimal) | Yes | Nullable. |
| `transfer_lots[].acquisition_transaction_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the lot was acquired. Nullable. |
| `transfer_lots[].client_acquisition_transaction_id` | string | No | The customer transaction ID that (if applicable) added the original lot to inventory. |
| `transfer_lots[].created_datetime` | string (date-time) | Yes | ISO-8601 timestamp representing when the transfer lot record was created. |
